en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Are you trying to go into a 
cryogenic stasis?

That's something that shows up 
a lot in anime and manga.

If something like that actually worked, 
wouldn't you want to try it out?

I'm just plain curious about how 
the world would look in 100 years!

That reminds me of the after school 
time high schoolers in anime have.

Spreaking of that, why do sweets 
in anime always look so delicious?

Especially when you're watching 
late at night...it's too cruel...

That's a common training method 
in anime and manga, but...

Is something wrong? If you need 
to talk, I'll listen.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tsumugi looks deep in thought...
